checked_scope: The sharp prediction criterion, tensor-repetition theorem, and finite-window continuum obstruction.
checks: The finite fiber’s union support S admits a feasible mixture strictly positive on S. Null directions sum to zero because observation columns normalize, so small positive/negative perturbations prove necessity of the restricted row-space prediction condition even at boundary observed laws.

A linear statistic separates the finite distinct observation columns; conditional products give moments θₖ^r through degree K−1, whose Vandermonde matrix proves full tensor-column rank at L≥K−1. Equal columns remain equal and K=1 needs no draws.
